meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有转录组数据,想找到基因间的调控网络
copy.tagline_en: Identify regulatory relationships between transcription factors and target genes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have transcriptomics data and want to uncover gene regulatory networks

howto.what: 它会读取你的基因表达矩阵,推断基因调控网络,产出列出转录因子、靶基因和重要性分数的表格;默认用本地全部核心并行计算。
howto.when: 当你要从转录组数据(批量 RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq 等)中找出转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时接管。

say.text: 把 importance 大于 0.5 的调控连接筛选出来存成新文件

howto.what_en: It reads your gene expression matrix, infers a gene regulatory network, and outputs a table of transcription factors, target genes and importance scores, using local cores or a cluster.
howto.when_en: Use it when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, etc.) to find transcription factor-target gene regulatory relationships.

say_en.text: Infer a GRN from expression_data.tsv with GRNBoost2, seed 777
say_en.note: Writes network.tsv with TF, target, importance

say_en.text: Filter regulatory links with importance above 0.5 into a new file
Infer separate networks for control and treatment_24h and save each
